en.title: ScanOld — Make any PDF look scanned. Free, in your browser.
en.desc: Age any PDF or image into a believable scanned copy, or conjure an old newspaper clipping from plain text. Free, no signup, files never leave your browser.
en.intro: Drop a PDF or image into ScanOld and it comes out looking like it went through a real scanner — tilted, yellowed, grainy, with the odd stain. Or skip the file entirely and type a few lines to print yourself an old newspaper clipping.
points: Two tools: Scan Lab for aging real documents, Relic Maker for inventing retro ones from plain text.
Eight one-click style presets: old newspaper, aged archive, kraft paper, photocopy, fax, mimeograph, red-header document and phone snapshot.
Every page is aged differently — angle, grain, brightness and stains vary page by page, the way a real stack of paper does.
100% local. Your files are processed in your browser and never uploaded anywhere. No signup, no watermarks.

zh.title: 造旧 ScanOld — 把任何 PDF 做成扫描件，免费在线
zh.desc: 把 PDF 或图片做旧成逼真的扫描件，或用文字生成复古旧报纸剪报。免费、免注册，文件全程不离开浏览器。
zh.h1: 把任何 PDF 做成扫描件
zh.intro: 把 PDF 或图片拖进造旧，出来就像真的过了一遍扫描仪——微微歪斜、泛黄、带颗粒，偶尔还有一块污渍。也可以不传文件，只打几行字，直接给自己印一张旧报纸剪报。
points: 两个工具：扫描质感工坊做旧真实文档，复古生成器用文字凭空造旧物。
八种一键风格：旧报纸、旧档案、牛皮纸、复印件、传真件、油印考卷、红头文件、随手拍。
每一页做旧程度都不同——角度、颗粒、明暗、污渍逐页变化，就像真的一叠纸。
100% 本地处理。文件在浏览器里处理，从不上传。免注册、无水印。

en.title: Scan Lab — Make any PDF look scanned | ScanOld
en.desc: Drop in a PDF or image, pick a scan style, fine-tune aging, tilt, noise and stains, and export a realistic scanned PDF. Searchable text layer included. 100% local.
en.h1: Scan Lab — make a PDF look scanned
en.intro: Upload a PDF or image, choose a scan style preset, then drag the aging, tilt, noise, yellowing and blur sliders until it looks right. Compare against the original with the split slider, then export a scanned-looking PDF.
points: Eight presets: Old Newspaper, Old Archive, Kraft Paper, Photocopy, Fax, Mimeographed Exam, Red-Header Document, Snapshot.
Per-page randomization — no two pages come out with the same angle or stains.
Zoom up to 400% and drag the compare line to inspect the difference pixel by pixel.
Keeps a searchable text layer: text-based PDFs stay searchable and copyable after aging.

zh.title: 扫描质感工坊 — 把 PDF 做成扫描件 | 造旧
zh.desc: 拖入 PDF 或图片，选扫描风格，微调做旧、歪斜、噪点与污渍，导出逼真的扫描 PDF，支持可搜索文字层。全程本地处理。
zh.h1: 扫描质感工坊 — 把 PDF 做成扫描件
zh.intro: 上传 PDF 或图片，选择扫描风格预设，再拖动做旧、歪斜、噪点、泛黄、模糊滑杆调到满意。用对比线左右查看原稿与效果，最后导出扫描感 PDF。
points: 八种预设：旧报纸、旧档案、牛皮纸、复印件、传真件、油印考卷、红头文件、随手拍。
逐页随机做旧——不会有两页的角度和污渍完全相同。
可放大到 400%，拖动对比线逐像素查看差异。
保留可搜索文字层：文字型 PDF 做旧后依然可搜索、可复制。

en.title: Relic Maker — Vintage newspaper generator | ScanOld
en.desc: Type plain text and instantly print an aged vintage newspaper clipping — columns, masthead, seal and all. Export as PNG or PDF.
en.intro: Type a masthead, a date, a headline and a story. Relic Maker sets it the way a real paper was set — multi-column, justified, with rules between columns — then ages the paper and stamps it. Export as PNG or PDF.
points: No design skills needed: columns, masthead, dateline and seal are laid out for you.
Old-style dating, aged paper and a slightly crooked red seal for authenticity.
Export a crisp PNG or a printable PDF — no watermark, no signup.
Made for gifts, party props, classroom history projects, murder-mystery clues, film props and memes.

zh.title: 复古生成器 — 旧报纸生成器 | 造旧
zh.desc: 输入文字，实时排出一版做旧的复古报纸剪报——分栏、报头、印章一应俱全。可导出 PNG 或 PDF。
zh.intro: 填上报名、日期、标题和正文，复古生成器按真实报纸的规矩排版——多栏、两端对齐、带栏线，再把纸做旧、盖上印章。可导出 PNG 或 PDF。
points: 不需要设计基础：分栏、报头、电头、印章自动排好。
老式纪年、做旧纸面、略微歪斜的朱红印章，还原真实感。
导出高清 PNG 或可打印 PDF，无水印、免注册。
适合礼物、活动道具、课堂历史作业、剧本杀线索、影视道具和表情包。

en.title: Scan style presets — Old newspaper, photocopy, fax and more | ScanOld
en.desc: Eight hand-tuned aging presets: Old Newspaper, Old Archive, Kraft Paper, Photocopies, Fax, Mimeographed Exam, Red-Header Document and Snapshot.
en.intro: Every preset is a complete set of aging parameters — paper tone, grain, tilt, contrast and stain pattern — tuned by hand so one click gets you a believable result.
points: Old Newspaper — newsprint grey, heavy grain, strong column shading.
Old Archive — browned paper, foxing spots, soft edges.
Photocopy — three generations of copier degradation, from clean to barely legible.
Fax — thermal-paper banding; Mimeograph — ink bleed and uneven inking; Snapshot — phone photo of a page, with shadow and perspective.

zh.title: 风格模板 — 旧报纸、复印件、传真等 8 种做旧风格 | 造旧
zh.desc: 八种精调做旧风格：旧报纸、旧档案、牛皮纸、复印件、传真件、油印考卷、红头文件、随手拍。
zh.intro: 每个预设都是一整套做旧参数——纸色、颗粒、歪斜、对比度、污渍分布，全部手工调校，一键就能出可信的效果。
points: 旧报纸——新闻纸灰、重颗粒、明显的栏间阴影。
旧档案——泛褐纸面、霉斑、边缘发虚。
复印件——三代复印劣化，从干净到几乎看不清。
传真件——热敏纸条纹；油印考卷——油墨扩散、着墨不均；随手拍——手机翻拍，带阴影和透视。

en.title: About ScanOld — vintage paper document studio
en.desc: ScanOld turns fresh pixels into paper with a past. Free, private (100% local processing), and built for creative, design and entertainment use.
en.intro: ScanOld is a small studio for vintage paper documents: it ages real files into believable scans, and invents retro documents out of plain text. Everything runs in your browser — there is no server, no upload, no account.
points: Built on open source: PDF.js for rendering, pdf-lib for assembly, html2canvas for image export.
Private by architecture: files never leave your device, so there is nothing to leak.
For creative, design and entertainment use only — never use it to forge documents for submission.

zh.title: 关于造旧 — 复古纸质文档工坊
zh.desc: 造旧把崭新的像素做成有年头的纸。免费、隐私（100% 本地处理），仅供创作、设计与娱乐使用。
zh.intro: 造旧是一间做复古纸质文档的小工坊：把真实文件做旧成可信的扫描件，也用文字凭空造出复古旧物。全部在浏览器里运行——没有服务器、没有上传、没有账号。
points: 站在开源肩膀上：PDF.js 负责渲染，pdf-lib 负责合成，html2canvas 负责图片导出。
架构即隐私：文件从不离开你的设备，也就没有可泄露的东西。
仅供创作、设计与娱乐使用，请勿用于伪造材料提交。
